definitions.ttft: first content timestamp - request start timestamp
definitions.request_latency: last content timestamp - request start timestamp; usage-only trailer excluded
definitions.first_chunk_convention: per_chunk_usage is False in this run; parser leaves first_content_chunk_tokens=None and ITL falls back to OSL-1. This assumes one token in the first content chunk. With opt-in per-chunk usage, a valid reported first-chunk count is subtracted; inconsistent counts fall back with a warning.
definitions.per_request_rate: 1 / ITL_seconds; mean is the arithmetic average of per-record rates
definitions.itl_percentiles: percentiles of one mean-interval value per request, not pooled individual token gaps
definitions.canonical_output_rate: total_osl / observation_duration; explicit analysis-window duration when set, otherwise BenchmarkDurationMetric
definitions.benchmark_duration: maximum response timestamp - minimum request timestamp
definitions.cache_read_percentage: 100 * total server-reported cache-read prompt tokens / total server-reported prompt tokens

scope: Source definitions and offline reproduction of existing measured records; no new benchmark or GPU use.
